name: human-losing-big
notes: H2: vanilla never marks a faction LosingBig by strength (Losing is tested first). With the fix, a faction below half its strongest rival's strength is LosingBig. Vanilla: only Losing appears. Vanilla also shows LosingBig in 2031 through its other route (every Earth interface orbit full), so the probe now counts the fix's own flips (losing-big-fix). First run: the Protectorate flipped Losing -> LosingBig in Dec 2031.
